entities.name: Query SepF protein
observations: 175 aa bacterial protein with calculated molecular weight 19,996 Da, theoretical pI 5.16, GRAVY −0.766, and estimated charge −7.17 at pH 7.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt SepF A0LTN7 from Acidothermus cellulolyticus; alignment identity and coverage are both 100%.
Contains a SepF domain (Pfam PF04472.18) at residues 87–158 with i-Evalue 8.3e−28.
Predicted function is cytoplasmic SepF, a divisome component recruited to the FtsZ Z-ring and involved in FtsZ-dependent cytokinesis and septum assembly.
Reference SepF proteins are homodimeric and interact with FtsZ.
Sequence-derived properties do not account for post-translational modification, processing, oligomerization, or ligands.

entities.name: FtsZ
observations: SepF reference annotations report interaction with FtsZ during bacterial cell division.
The query protein is therefore inferred to participate in Z-ring-associated divisome organization through FtsZ interaction.

entities.name: FtsZ-dependent cytokinesis
observations: SepF reference annotations associate the protein with FtsZ-dependent cytokinesis and cell septum assembly.
